svg.title: A navy phone on a paper background, with an English and Amharic caption under the screen.
svg.desc: A simple drawing, not a photograph. A tall rounded rectangle stands in for a phone. Inside it, a smaller rectangle is the screen. Under the phone, two lines of caption text are suggested by a black bar and a shorter bar. Nothing in the drawing depends on colour alone: the phone has a dark outline and the caption bars are separate shapes.
